source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

strategy.summary: Use the left orbit and the upper-right flipper to keep the ball up top, repeatedly complete the upper three-bank, and let the X-O card build from incidental standup hits.

steps.text: Short-plunge below the shooter-lane switch before the timed skill shot expires for 100,000.
From the lower flippers, shoot the outer-left orbit or feed the upper-right flipper.
Use the upper-right flipper to complete the upper three-bank. Each completion raises both the bank and outer-left-lane values.
Let standup hits fill the X-O card. If one symbol already dominates the card, time later target hits so they keep that same symbol.
Repeat the upper-playfield route. The completed card and any three-in-a-row bonuses carry between balls.

cautions.issue: Standup-target rebounds can drain through the center.
cautions.response: Use the upper-playfield route as the backbone and chase a card symbol only when one safe hit completes a valuable line.

strategy.simpleOverview: X's & O's carries upper-bank, outer-left-lane, and completed X-O-card values between balls. The left orbit and upper-right flipper keep the ball near the drop bank while incidental standup hits fill the card.
strategy.overview: The repeatable upper-playfield loop in X's & O's raises values that carry between balls, while standups fill the carried X-O card. Take the timed short-plunge award, use the left orbit and upper-right flipper to repeat the upper three-bank, and favor one symbol when possible.
